tools.name: bpmn_create_diagram
tools.description: Create a new BPMN 2.0 diagram with a single StartEvent, replacing the current canvas.

tools.name: bpmn_import_xml
tools.description: Import a complete BPMN 2.0 XML string into the modeler.

tools.name: bpmn_export_xml
tools.description: Export the current BPMN 2.0 diagram as formatted XML.

tools.name: bpmn_export_svg
tools.description: Export the current BPMN 2.0 diagram as an SVG string.

tools.name: bpmn_get_diagram_summary
tools.description: Get a structured JSON summary of all shapes, connections, labels, and bounds currently in the BPMN diagram.

tools.name: bpmn_add_element
tools.description: Add a BPMN element (e.g. bpmn:Task, bpmn:UserTask, bpmn:ServiceTask, bpmn:ExclusiveGateway, bpmn:ParallelGateway, bpmn:StartEvent, bpmn:EndEvent) to the diagram. Can auto-place and connect from sourceElementId.

type.description: BPMN element type (e.g. bpmn:UserTask, bpmn:ExclusiveGateway, bpmn:EndEvent)

parentId.description: Optional parent container ID (defaults to root process/plane)

sourceElementId.description: Optional existing element ID to auto-place after and connect from

connectFromSource.description: Connect from sourceElementId with SequenceFlow (default true when sourceElementId is set)

flowName.description: Optional label for the connecting sequence flow

tools.name: bpmn_connect_elements
tools.description: Connect two existing BPMN elements with a SequenceFlow, MessageFlow, or Association.

type.description: Optional connection type (e.g. bpmn:SequenceFlow, bpmn:MessageFlow, bpmn:Association)

name.description: Optional label / condition text on the connection

tools.name: bpmn_update_element
tools.description: Update an element label, businessObject properties, position (dx/dy or x/y), or dimensions.

elementId.description: ID of the element to update

properties.description: Key-value properties to set on the BPMN businessObject

tools.name: bpmn_delete_elements
tools.description: Delete one or more BPMN elements by their IDs.

elementIds.description: Array of element IDs to remove

tools.name: bpmn_replace_element
tools.description: Morph/replace an existing element with a different BPMN type (e.g. bpmn:Task -> bpmn:UserTask).

tools.name: bpmn_undo
tools.description: Undo the last modeling action in the BPMN editor.

tools.name: bpmn_redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone modeling action in the BPMN editor.

tools.name: bpmn_zoom_fit
tools.description: Fit the BPMN diagram to the viewport or set a specific zoom level.

level.description: Zoom level: "fit-viewport" (default) or numeric string like "1.0"

tools.name: bpmn_build_process
tools.description: Build a complete BPMN process from a list of nodes and flows with automatic left-to-right layout.

clearExisting.description: Clear existing diagram before building (default true)

nodes.description: List of BPMN nodes to create

type.description: e.g. bpmn:StartEvent, bpmn:UserTask, bpmn:ServiceTask, bpmn:ExclusiveGateway, bpmn:EndEvent

flows.description: Sequence flows connecting nodes by their IDs
